network_status.summary_it: Le fonti tecniche regionali consultate non confermano questo crollo a Bussoleno; la stima di Susa non viene associata a un evento non ancora identificato con certezza.

caveats: Source review is complete, but no value compatible with the controlled event identity and bridge section is assigned.
A regional flood observation is not transferred across unresolved watercourse or event identities.
The encoded failure process retains its database evidence level and does not prove causation beyond the cited sources.
Rainfall remains separate and is not converted into stage or discharge.
